# Feature: User AI Provider Credentials

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-10 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Generic per-user AI provider credentials (Settings → AI → Bild/3D/Video/Audio) so users can store a validated API key (starting with Meshy for image + 3D), see when it was added and available credits, and use that key for generate paths. **Prod uses user keys only** (no host `MESHY_API_KEY` fallback unless explicit local/CI allow flag). Roadmap: chat-driven (Stufe B) — AI settings / Meshy BYOK.

## Preconditions

- Signed-in user opens Einstellungen → AI.
- Edge Functions + migration `020_user_ai_provider_credentials` applied.
- `CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY` set on Edge (32-byte secret) for upsert/decrypt.
- Valid Meshy API key available for live validate (or mock path in CI).

## Happy Path

- [ ] AI sub-tabs Bild and 3D show Meshy provider card; Video/Audio show empty “noch keine Provider” state.
- [ ] User pastes Meshy key → Speichern → Edge validates via balance API → stores encrypted secret; UI shows `added_at`, credits, `keyHint` — never the full key again.
- [ ] Refresh credits and remove key work; after remove, generate is `not-configured` (unless local host-key allow).
- [ ] Workbench Image-to-3D / Thumbnail Meshy generate use the user Meshy credential when present; cardinality: one credential row per `(user_id, provider_id)`.
- [ ] Prod fail-closed: without user key and without `AI_PROVIDER_ALLOW_HOST_KEYS=1`, `meshyConfigured=false` even if host `MESHY_API_KEY` is set.
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict); #94 layers respected.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Invalid / rejected Meshy key → nothing stored; German error; previous credential (if any) unchanged.
- [ ] Missing encryption key on Edge → upsert fails closed with clear message.
- [ ] Rate-limited upsert/refresh → 429-style error, no secret leak in logs/response.
- [ ] Same Meshy credential appears under Bild and 3D (shared provider_id, dual modalities).

## Regression

- [ ] GLB upload and thumbnail upload still work without Meshy.
- [ ] Profile other tabs unchanged; architecture-boundary-check passes.
- [ ] Mock Meshy (`ITEM_*_MESHY_MOCK=1`) still enables generate in CI without user key.

## Assumptions

- Host `MESHY_API_KEY` remains for local/CI only when `AI_PROVIDER_ALLOW_HOST_KEYS=1` (or mock flags).
- Preference toggles under AI tabs stay non-persisted stubs; this ticket is credentials only.
- Encryption: AES-256-GCM with `CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY`; table readable only via service_role Edge.

## Security Coverage

| Item | Status | How |
|------|--------|-----|
| F-05 Client API keys | PASS | No `VITE_*` Meshy/provider keys; key only in upsert body once |
| B-01 Authn on mutate | PASS | JWT required on `ai-provider-credentials` |
| B-02 Authz owner | PASS | Rows scoped to `auth.uid()` / JWT user_id; service_role only |
| B-04 Injection | PASS | Parameterized PostgREST; no SQL concat |
| B-10 Fail-closed secrets | PASS | Prod: no user key → not-configured; encrypt key required for store |
| P-02 Sensitive logs | PASS | No full key / ciphertext in logs or client responses |
| P-04 Rate limit | PASS | Server rate limit on upsert/refresh |
| P-06 Cardinality | PASS | One credential per user+provider; upsert replaces same row |

Out of scope: B-07/B-08/B-09 (no permission-admin).

## Implementation Notes

- Migration `020_user_ai_provider_credentials.sql` — encrypted vault + rate-limit RPC (service_role only).
- Edge `ai-provider-credentials` + registry (`meshy` → image+3d); validate via Meshy balance; AES-GCM (`CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY`).
- Resolve: `resolveMeshyApiKeyForUser` / `isMeshyConfiguredForUser` wired into `item-thumbnail` + `item-model3d` (prod user-key only unless `AI_PROVIDER_ALLOW_HOST_KEYS=1` or mock).
- Domain `src/domains/ai-providers`, infrastructure `ai-provider-credentials-service`, UI `AiProviderCredentialsPanel` in Profile AI tabs.
- Contract: `scripts/ai-provider-credentials-check.mjs` in test-gate; Deno tests `ai-provider-credentials_test.ts`.
- Docs/README/.env.example/docker-compose updated.
- Known limitation: operator must set `CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY` on Edge and restart edge for Settings save to work; Video/Audio tabs empty until new registry entries.
